source_refs.note: Quantitative Analysis: a main subheading of 14.4 Simple Harmonic Motion and Uniform Circular Motion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 26-26.

blocks.text: Consider a motion of particle P along the circumference of circle of radius x₀ with uniform angular velocity ω. Its linear velocity at point P is along the tangent (vₚ = rω). Let Q be the projection which oscillates along the diameter of circle about the mean position O. When the body is at point P its projection is at distance x from the mean position.
